type futurePostRevisionOriginalForkReceiverRow struct {
	ID, Flow, Type, State string
	Fields                map[string]any
}

type futurePostRevisionOriginalForkReceiverJourneyOptions struct {
	nested          bool
	selectedMissing bool
	repeated        bool
}

type futurePostRevisionOriginalForkReceiverProducerEvidence struct {
	Source     events.RoutingSource
	Name, Mode string
}

func futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverProducerEvidence(t *testing.T, rt servedControlProofRuntime, runID, eventID string) futurePostRevisionOriginalForkReceiverProducerEvidence {
	t.Helper()
	var evidence futurePostRevisionOriginalForkReceiverProducerEvidence
	var kind, authority, routeJSON string
	if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT routing_source_kind,COALESCE(routing_source_authority,''),CAST(source_route AS TEXT),event_name,execution_mode FROM events WHERE run_id=$1 AND event_id=$2`, runID, eventID).Scan(&kind, &authority, &routeJSON, &evidence.Name, &evidence.Mode); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var route events.RouteIdentity
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(routeJSON), &route); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var err error
	evidence.Source, err = events.RestoreRoutingSource(kind, route, authority)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return evidence
}

func futurePostRevisionOriginalWaitForkReceiverSourceCompletion(t *testing.T, rt servedControlProofRuntime, runID string) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(servedProofPollDeadline)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		var incomplete int
		// Successful pipeline settlement owns the handoff stamp and receipt in
		// one transaction, after recursive child publication has returned.
		if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_deliveries d WHERE d.run_id=$1 AND
			(d.status IN ('pending','in_progress') OR d.continuation_handoff_at IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS
			(SELECT 1 FROM event_receipts r WHERE r.event_id=d.event_id AND r.subscriber_type='platform' AND r.subscriber_id='pipeline'))`, runID).Scan(&incomplete); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if incomplete == 0 {
			return
		}
		time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	t.Fatalf("source pipeline completion did not finish: %s", servedEventPublishDebugSummary(t, rt.DB, rt.Backend, runID))
}

// Refusal snapshots cover all application base tables, not merely the child
// tables that a successful fork would populate. Internal DB objects are excluded.
func futurePostRevisionOriginalSnapshotForkReceiverApplication(t *testing.T, rt servedControlProofRuntime) map[string][]string {
	t.Helper()
	opts := &sql.TxOptions{ReadOnly: true}
	query := `SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name`
	if rt.Backend == "postgres" {
		opts.Isolation = sql.LevelRepeatableRead
		query = `SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_type='BASE TABLE' ORDER BY table_name`
	}
	tx, err := rt.DB.BeginTx(context.Background(), opts)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer tx.Rollback()
	rows, err := tx.Query(query)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var tables []string
	for rows.Next() {
		var table string
		if err := rows.Scan(&table); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		tables = append(tables, table)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	rows.Close()
	out := map[string][]string{}
	for _, table := range tables {
		rows, err := tx.Query(`SELECT * FROM "` + strings.ReplaceAll(table, `"`, `""`) + `"`)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		columns, err := rows.Columns()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(columns)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		out[table+"/columns"] = []string{string(encoded)}
		out[table] = []string{}
		for rows.Next() {
			values, pointers := make([]any, len(columns)), make([]any, len(columns))
			for i := range values {
				pointers[i] = &values[i]
			}
			if err := rows.Scan(pointers...); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			for i, value := range values {
				if raw, ok := value.([]byte); ok {
					values[i] = string(raw)
				}
			}
			encoded, err := json.Marshal(values)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			out[table] = append(out[table], string(encoded))
		}
		if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		rows.Close()
		sort.Strings(out[table])
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return out
}

func futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverRows(t *testing.T, rt servedControlProofRuntime, runID string) map[string]futurePostRevisionOriginalForkReceiverRow {
	t.Helper()
	rows, err := rt.DB.Query(`SELECT entity_id,flow_instance,entity_type,current_state,CAST(fields AS TEXT) FROM entity_state WHERE run_id=$1 ORDER BY entity_id`, runID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	out := map[string]futurePostRevisionOriginalForkReceiverRow{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var row futurePostRevisionOriginalForkReceiverRow
		var raw string
		if err := rows.Scan(&row.ID, &row.Flow, &row.Type, &row.State, &raw); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &row.Fields); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, duplicate := out[row.Flow]; duplicate {
			t.Fatalf("fixture has duplicate owner rows for %s", row.Flow)
		}
		out[row.Flow] = row
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return out
}

func futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverCompanions(t *testing.T, rt servedControlProofRuntime, runID string) map[string][]string {
	t.Helper()
	out := map[string][]string{}
	for _, table := range []string{"flow_instances", "flow_instance_runtime_readiness"} {
		rows, err := rt.DB.Query(`SELECT * FROM `+table+` WHERE run_id=$1`, runID)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		columns, err := rows.Columns()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		out[table] = []string{}
		for rows.Next() {
			values, pointers := make([]any, len(columns)), make([]any, len(columns))
			for i := range values {
				pointers[i] = &values[i]
			}
			if err := rows.Scan(pointers...); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			for i, value := range values {
				if raw, ok := value.([]byte); ok {
					values[i] = string(raw)
				}
			}
			encoded, err := json.Marshal(values)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			out[table] = append(out[table], string(encoded))
		}
		if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		rows.Close()
		sort.Strings(out[table])
	}
	return out
}

func futurePostRevisionOriginalRequireForkReceiverEffect(t *testing.T, rt servedControlProofRuntime, runID, sourceEvent, path, label, kind, entityID string) events.DeliveryRoute {
	t.Helper()
	var matched []servedForkDeliveryEvidence
	var deliveryID string
	for id, delivery := range readServedForkDeliveryEvidence(t, rt, runID) {
		node, ok := delivery.route.Recipient.Node()
		if delivery.eventID == sourceEvent && ok && node.FlowPath() == path && node.NodeID() == "collector" {
			matched = append(matched, delivery)
			deliveryID = id
		}
	}
	if len(matched) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%s/%s: got %d exact receiver deliveries", runID, path, len(matched))
	}
	route := matched[0].route
	handler, local, ok := route.ConnectClaim.NodeHandlerOwner()
	if !ok || handler.FlowPath() != path || handler.NodeID() != "collector" || local != "work.ready" {
		t.Fatalf("lost exact selected handler/local event: %+v", route)
	}
	if target := route.Target.Route(); route.Target.Code() != kind || target.FlowID != path || target.FlowInstance != path || target.EntityID != entityID {
		t.Fatalf("%s/%s: target=%+v kind=%s; want %s entity=%s; rows=%+v", runID, path, target, route.Target.Code(), kind, entityID, futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverRows(t, rt, runID))
	}
	var status, outcome, failure string
	var claim, outcomeClaim, outcomes int
	if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT d.status,d.claim_version,o.claim_version,o.outcome,COALESCE(CAST(o.failure AS TEXT),'') FROM event_deliveries d JOIN event_delivery_outcomes o ON o.delivery_id=d.delivery_id WHERE d.run_id=$1 AND d.delivery_id=$2`, runID, deliveryID).Scan(&status, &claim, &outcomeClaim, &outcome, &failure); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_delivery_outcomes WHERE delivery_id=$1`, deliveryID).Scan(&outcomes); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if status != "delivered" || outcome != "delivered" || claim != 1 || outcomeClaim != 1 || outcomes != 1 {
		logServedForkHandlerDiagnostics(t, rt)
		t.Fatalf("%s/%s: final settlement status=%s outcome=%s claim=%d/%d count=%d failure=%s", runID, path, status, outcome, claim, outcomeClaim, outcomes, failure)
	}
	var public operatorread.OperatorEventFull
	requireServedJSONRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, "event.get", map[string]any{"event_id": sourceEvent}, &public)
	found := false
	for _, delivery := range public.Deliveries {
		if delivery.DeliveryID == deliveryID {
			found = true
			want := operatorread.OperatorDeliveryTarget{Kind: kind, FlowID: path, FlowInstance: path, EntityID: entityID}
			if delivery.Target != want || delivery.Status != "delivered" || public.RunID != runID {
				t.Fatalf("public receiver authority: %+v want %+v", delivery, want)
			}
		}
	}
	if !found {
		t.Fatal("public readback omitted receiver delivery")
	}
	var effectID, rawSource, payload string
	if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT event_id,CAST(source_route AS TEXT),CAST(payload AS TEXT) FROM events WHERE run_id=$1 AND event_name=$2 AND source_event_id=$3`, runID, path+"/receiver.finished", sourceEvent).Scan(&effectID, &rawSource, &payload); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s final effect: %v", path, err)
	}
	var effectSource events.RouteIdentity
	var effectPayload map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(rawSource), &effectSource); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(payload), &effectPayload); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if effectSource.FlowID != path || effectSource.FlowInstance != path || effectSource.EntityID != entityID || effectPayload["owner"] != label || effectPayload["token"] != "receiver-proof" {
		t.Fatalf("receiver final effect borrowed ownership: source=%+v payload=%v", effectSource, effectPayload)
	}
	var count int
	if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE run_id=$1 AND event_name=$2 AND source_event_id=$3`, runID, path+"/receiver.finished", sourceEvent).Scan(&count); err != nil || count != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("final effect count=%d err=%v", count, err)
	}
	requireServedJSONRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, "event.get", map[string]any{"event_id": effectID}, &public)
	if public.RunID != runID || len(public.Deliveries) != 0 || public.NoDelivery == nil || len(public.DeadLetters) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("external final effect public disposition: %+v", public)
	}
	return route
}

func futurePostRevisionOriginalRunForkReceiverOwnershipJourney(t *testing.T, backend servedparity.Backend, receivers []canonicalrouting.ForkReceiver, entitylessProducer bool, options ...futurePostRevisionOriginalForkReceiverJourneyOptions) {
	t.Helper()
	var option futurePostRevisionOriginalForkReceiverJourneyOptions
	if len(options) != 0 {
		option = options[0]
	}
	var selected *selectedStoreOwner
	previous := projectRuntimePersistenceForServe
	projectRuntimePersistenceForServe = func(owner *selectedStoreOwner) serveRuntimePersistence {
		selected = owner
		return previous(owner)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { projectRuntimePersistenceForServe = previous })
	root := canonicalrouting.CopyForkReceiverOwnership(t, receivers, entitylessProducer)
	if option.repeated {
		root = canonicalrouting.CopyForkReceiverRepeatedOwnership(t, receivers)
	}
	prefix, seedName, requestName := "", "start.seeded", "start.requested"
	if option.nested {
		root = canonicalrouting.CopyForkReceiverNestedOwnership(t, receivers)
		prefix, seedName, requestName = "branch/", "outer.seeded", "outer.requested"
	}
	rt := startServedTestSetupEntitiesProofRuntimeFromSource(t, backend, root)
	seed := requireServedEventPublishRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, map[string]any{
		"event_name": seedName, "bundle_hash": rt.BundleHash,
		"payload": map[string]any{"token": "receiver-proof"}, "idempotency_key": "ownership-seed",
	})
	waitServedRunDeliveryQuiescence(t, rt.DB, rt.Backend, seed.RunID)
	futurePostRevisionOriginalWaitForkReceiverSourceCompletion(t, rt, seed.RunID)
	request := map[string]any{"event_name": requestName, "run_id": seed.RunID, "source_event_id": seed.EventID,
		"payload": map[string]any{"token": "receiver-proof"}, "idempotency_key": "ownership-request"}
	started := requireServedEventPublishRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, request)
	waitServedRunDeliveryQuiescence(t, rt.DB, rt.Backend, seed.RunID)
	futurePostRevisionOriginalWaitForkReceiverSourceCompletion(t, rt, seed.RunID)
	if started.RunID != seed.RunID {
		t.Fatal("second source ingress escaped the seeded run")
	}
	var frontier string
	if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT event_id FROM events WHERE run_id=$1 AND event_name=$2`, seed.RunID, prefix+"producer/work.ready").Scan(&frontier); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("actual producer did not emit fork frontier: %v", err)
	}
	frontiers := []string{frontier}
	if option.repeated {
		request["idempotency_key"] = "ownership-request-second"
		second := requireServedEventPublishRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, request)
		if second.EventID == started.EventID || second.RunID != seed.RunID {
			t.Fatal("distinct source occurrence collapsed")
		}
		waitServedRunDeliveryQuiescence(t, rt.DB, rt.Backend, seed.RunID)
		futurePostRevisionOriginalWaitForkReceiverSourceCompletion(t, rt, seed.RunID)
		if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT event_id FROM events WHERE run_id=$1 AND event_name=$2 AND event_id<>$3`, seed.RunID, prefix+"producer/work.ready", frontier).Scan(&frontier); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		frontiers = append(frontiers, frontier)
		beforeDuplicate := readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, seed.RunID)
		duplicate := requireServedEventPublishRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, request)
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(second, duplicate) || !reflect.DeepEqual(beforeDuplicate, readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, seed.RunID)) {
			t.Fatal("duplicate ingress rematerialized a source occurrence")
		}
	}
	sourceRows := futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverRows(t, rt, seed.RunID)
	producerEvidence := futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverProducerEvidence(t, rt, seed.RunID, frontier)
	producer, producerExists := sourceRows[prefix+"producer"]
	if producerExists == entitylessProducer || (producerExists && (producer.Type != "work" || producer.Fields["marker"] != "producer-owned")) {
		t.Fatalf("source producer prerequisite: %+v", sourceRows)
	}
	producerRoute := producerEvidence.Source.Route()
	if producerEvidence.Source.Kind() != events.RoutingSourceStaticFlow || producerRoute.FlowID != prefix+"producer" || producerRoute.FlowInstance != prefix+"producer" || producerRoute.EntityID != producer.ID {
		t.Fatalf("source event lacks independently expected producer ownership: %+v rows=%+v", producerEvidence, sourceRows)
	}
	sourceRoutes := map[string]events.DeliveryRoute{}
	for _, receiver := range receivers {
		path := prefix + receiver.Path
		kind, id := "entityless_receiver", ""
		if receiver.Policy != canonicalrouting.ForkReceiverOptionalAbsent {
			row, exists := sourceRows[path]
			marker := receiver.Path + "-owned"
			kind = "existing_entity"
			if receiver.Policy == canonicalrouting.ForkReceiverAutoMaterializing || receiver.Policy == canonicalrouting.ForkReceiverExplicitCreate {
				kind, marker = "materializing_entity", receiver.Path+"-created"
			}
			if !exists || row.ID == producer.ID || row.Type != "receipt" || row.State != "active" || row.Fields["marker"] != marker {
				t.Fatalf("independent source receiver prerequisite: %s %+v", receiver.Path, sourceRows)
			}
			id = row.ID
		} else if _, exists := sourceRows[path]; exists {
			t.Fatalf("optional source receiver invented state: %+v", sourceRows)
		}
		for _, occurrence := range frontiers {
			sourceRoutes[path] = futurePostRevisionOriginalRequireForkReceiverEffect(t, rt, seed.RunID, occurrence, path, receiver.Path, kind, id)
		}
	}
	if option.repeated {
		family, ok := selected.RunFork()
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("missing source planner")
		}
		plan, err := family.Plan(servedControlProofAuthorActivityContext(t, rt), runfork.RunForkPlanRequest{SourceRunID: seed.RunID, At: frontier})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		for _, occurrence := range frontiers {
			if got := futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverProducerEvidence(t, rt, seed.RunID, occurrence); got != producerEvidence {
				t.Fatalf("same-owner occurrence lost producer or execution mode: first=%+v got=%+v", producerEvidence, got)
			}
			for _, receiver := range receivers {
				matches := 0
				for _, item := range plan.PendingWork {
					node, isNode := item.DeliveryRoute.Recipient.Node()
					if item.EventID == occurrence && isNode && node.FlowPath() == receiver.Path && node.NodeID() == "collector" {
						matches++
						if !reflect.DeepEqual(item.DeliveryRoute.Normalized(), sourceRoutes[receiver.Path]) {
							t.Fatalf("fixed snapshot collapsed same-owner delivery evidence: %+v", item)
						}
					}
				}
				if matches != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("fixed snapshot event=%s receiver=%s associations=%d, want one", occurrence, receiver.Path, matches)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	t.Logf("source success reached: run=%s frontier=%s receivers=%d", seed.RunID, frontier, len(receivers))
	if option.nested {
		siblingSeed := requireServedEventPublishRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, map[string]any{"event_name": seedName, "bundle_hash": rt.BundleHash,
			"payload": map[string]any{"token": "receiver-proof"}, "idempotency_key": "ownership-sibling-seed"})
		waitServedRunDeliveryQuiescence(t, rt.DB, rt.Backend, siblingSeed.RunID)
		futurePostRevisionOriginalWaitForkReceiverSourceCompletion(t, rt, siblingSeed.RunID)
		requireServedEventPublishRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, map[string]any{"event_name": requestName, "run_id": siblingSeed.RunID, "source_event_id": siblingSeed.EventID,
			"payload": map[string]any{"token": "receiver-proof"}, "idempotency_key": "ownership-sibling-request"})
		waitServedRunDeliveryQuiescence(t, rt.DB, rt.Backend, siblingSeed.RunID)
		futurePostRevisionOriginalWaitForkReceiverSourceCompletion(t, rt, siblingSeed.RunID)
		if siblingSeed.RunID == seed.RunID {
			t.Fatal("independent sibling run collapsed")
		}
		var siblingFrontier string
		if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT event_id FROM events WHERE run_id=$1 AND event_name=$2`, siblingSeed.RunID, prefix+"producer/work.ready").Scan(&siblingFrontier); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		siblingRows := futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverRows(t, rt, siblingSeed.RunID)
		for _, receiver := range receivers {
			path := prefix + receiver.Path
			if siblingRows[path].ID != sourceRows[path].ID || siblingRows[path].Flow != path {
				t.Fatalf("sibling fixture did not exercise same entity ID in separate run: source=%+v sibling=%+v", sourceRows[path], siblingRows[path])
			}
			futurePostRevisionOriginalRequireForkReceiverEffect(t, rt, siblingSeed.RunID, siblingFrontier, path, receiver.Path, "existing_entity", siblingRows[path].ID)
		}
		siblingDomain, siblingCompanions := readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, siblingSeed.RunID), futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverCompanions(t, rt, siblingSeed.RunID)
		defer func() {
			if !reflect.DeepEqual(siblingDomain, readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, siblingSeed.RunID)) || !reflect.DeepEqual(siblingCompanions, futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverCompanions(t, rt, siblingSeed.RunID)) {
				t.Error("fork mutated the independently executed sibling run")
			}
		}()
	}
	before := readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, seed.RunID)
	beforeCompanions := futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverCompanions(t, rt, seed.RunID)
	defer func() {
		if after := readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, seed.RunID); !reflect.DeepEqual(before, after) {
			t.Errorf("fork mutated source domain: before=%v after=%v", before, after)
		}
		if after := futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverCompanions(t, rt, seed.RunID); !reflect.DeepEqual(beforeCompanions, after) {
			t.Errorf("fork mutated source companion/readiness rows: before=%v after=%v", beforeCompanions, after)
		}
	}()
	params := map[string]any{"source_run_id": seed.RunID, "fork_event_id": frontier, "confirm_source_freeze": true, "idempotency_key": "ownership-fork"}
	if option.selectedMissing {
		// This is changed-selected execution through the actual owner, not a
		// mutation of the successful source bundle or a forged route plan.
		selectedRoot := canonicalrouting.CopyForkReceiverOwnership(t, []canonicalrouting.ForkReceiver{{Path: "consumer", Policy: canonicalrouting.ForkReceiverRequiredMissing}}, false)
		bundle := loadWorkflowValidationBundleAt(t, selectedRoot)
		if selected == nil {
			t.Fatal("missing selected store owner")
		}
		seedStandingRuntimeContextBundle(t, selected.SourceArtifactWriter(), bundle)
		selectedHash := servedEventPublishFixtureBundleHash(t, selectedRoot)
		family, ok := selected.RunFork()
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("missing actual fork executor")
		}
		beforeRefusal := futurePostRevisionOriginalSnapshotForkReceiverApplication(t, rt)
		for attempt := 0; attempt < 2; attempt++ {
			result, err := family.Execute(servedControlProofAuthorActivityContext(t, rt), runforkexecution.SelectedContractExecutionRequest{
				SourceRunID: seed.RunID, At: frontier, ConfirmSourceFreeze: true, ExpectedBundleHash: selectedHash,
				SourceLoader:      runforkexecution.SourceArtifactSelectedContractSourceLoader{RepoRoot: repoRootForTest(), PlatformSpecPath: filepath.Join(repoRootForTest(), defaultPlatformSpecPath), Store: selected.SourceArtifactStore()},
				ContractSelection: runfork.RunForkContractSelection{Mode: runfork.RunForkContractSelectionModeBundleHash, BundleHash: selectedHash},
				AgentRuntime:      runforkexecution.SelectedContractAgentRuntimeOptions{ExecutionPosture: rt.Runtime.ExecutionPosture},
			})
			if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "receiver target owner is missing") || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "consumer") || result.ExecutedEventCount != 0 || result.Materialization.ForkRunID != "" {
				t.Fatalf("required missing receiver must reject before materialization: result=%+v err=%v", result, err)
			}
			if after := futurePostRevisionOriginalSnapshotForkReceiverApplication(t, rt); !reflect.DeepEqual(beforeRefusal, after) {
				t.Fatalf("required-missing attempt %d changed application state", attempt)
			}
		}
		return
	}
	var fork, replay apiv1.RunForkExecutionResult
	requireServedJSONRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, "run.fork", params, &fork)
	if fork.SourceRunID != seed.RunID || fork.ForkEventID != frontier || fork.ForkRunID == "" || fork.ForkRunID == seed.RunID || fork.ExecutedEventCount != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("fork identity: %+v", fork)
	}
	waitServedRunDeliveryQuiescence(t, rt.DB, rt.Backend, fork.ForkRunID)
	childRows := futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverRows(t, rt, fork.ForkRunID)
	childEvent := activityidentity.ForkLineageEventID(fork.ForkRunID, frontier)
	// This persisted child event has passed backend source-event loading and
	// container preparation/publication. Compare their composition, not helpers.
	childProducer := futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverProducerEvidence(t, rt, fork.ForkRunID, childEvent)
	if childProducer != producerEvidence {
		t.Fatalf("backend/container composition changed immutable non-root producer: source=%+v child=%+v", producerEvidence, childProducer)
	}
	if producerRoute.EntityID != "" {
		row := childRows[producerRoute.FlowInstance]
		if row.ID != producerRoute.EntityID || row.Type != producer.Type || row.Flow != producer.Flow {
			t.Fatalf("child producer route has no exact physical owner: route=%+v row=%+v", producerRoute, row)
		}
	}
	for _, receiver := range receivers {
		path := prefix + receiver.Path
		sourceRoute := sourceRoutes[path]
		id := sourceRoute.Target.Route().EntityID
		kind := sourceRoute.Target.Code()
		childRoute := futurePostRevisionOriginalRequireForkReceiverEffect(t, rt, fork.ForkRunID, childEvent, path, receiver.Path, kind, id)
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(childRoute.ConnectClaim, sourceRoute.ConnectClaim) {
			t.Fatalf("fork changed exact compiled connect claim: source=%+v child=%+v", sourceRoute, childRoute)
		}
		if id == "" {
			var companions int
			if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flow_instances WHERE run_id=$1 AND instance_path=$2`, fork.ForkRunID, path).Scan(&companions); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if _, exists := childRows[path]; exists || companions != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("optional child fabricated entity/companion: %+v count=%d", childRows, companions)
			}
		} else if got := childRows[path]; !reflect.DeepEqual(got, sourceRows[path]) {
			t.Fatalf("receiver state transferred or changed: source=%+v child=%+v", sourceRows[path], got)
		}
	}
	if producerExists && !reflect.DeepEqual(childRows[prefix+"producer"], producer) {
		t.Fatalf("producer state was rehomed: source=%+v child=%+v", producer, childRows)
	}
	if entitylessProducer {
		if _, exists := childRows[prefix+"producer"]; exists {
			t.Fatalf("entityless producer acquired state: %+v", childRows)
		}
	}
	rootRow := childRows[fork.ForkRunID]
	if rootRow.ID != fork.ForkRunID || rootRow.Type != "root" || rootRow.Fields["marker"] != "root-owned" || rootRow.State != "active" {
		t.Fatalf("root remap/restoration: %+v", childRows)
	}
	childBefore := readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, fork.ForkRunID)
	requireServedJSONRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, "run.fork", params, &replay)
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(fork, replay) || !reflect.DeepEqual(childBefore, readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, fork.ForkRunID)) {
		t.Fatal("same-key fork replay changed response, committed targets, or final effects")
	}
}

func TestFuturePostRevisionOriginalSelectedForkReceiverAcquisitionCapabilityRefusalBothStores(t *testing.T) {
	for _, backend := range []servedparity.Backend{servedparity.BackendDefaultSQLite, servedparity.BackendExplicitPostgres} {
		t.Run(string(backend)+"/template_resolution_create", func(t *testing.T) {
			root := canonicalrouting.CopyTemplateCreateResolution(t, canonicalrouting.TemplateCreateResolutionOptions{Mint: canonicalrouting.CreateMintUUID})
			rt := startServedTestSetupEntitiesProofRuntimeFromSource(t, backend, root)
			seed := requireServedEventPublishRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, map[string]any{"event_name": "producer/validation.triggered", "bundle_hash": rt.BundleHash,
				"payload": map[string]any{"candidate": "fork-capability"}, "idempotency_key": "capability-source"})
			waitServedRunDeliveryQuiescence(t, rt.DB, rt.Backend, seed.RunID)
			futurePostRevisionOriginalWaitForkReceiverSourceCompletion(t, rt, seed.RunID)
			var frontier, entityID, instancePath string
			if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT event_id FROM events WHERE run_id=$1 AND event_name='producer/validation.requested'`, seed.RunID).Scan(&frontier); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT entity_id,flow_instance FROM entity_state WHERE run_id=$1 AND entity_type='validation_case'`, seed.RunID).Scan(&entityID, &instancePath); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if entityID == "" || !strings.HasPrefix(instancePath, "validator/") {
				t.Fatalf("source did not actually create validator: %s/%s", entityID, instancePath)
			}
			var incomplete int
			if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_deliveries WHERE run_id=$1 AND status<>'delivered'`, seed.RunID).Scan(&incomplete); err != nil || incomplete != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("dynamic source did not settle: %d %v", incomplete, err)
			}
			requireReceiverPublicReadback(t, rt, seed.RunID)
			before := futurePostRevisionOriginalSnapshotForkReceiverApplication(t, rt)
			params := map[string]any{"source_run_id": seed.RunID, "fork_event_id": frontier, "confirm_source_freeze": true, "idempotency_key": "capability-fork"}
			for attempt := 0; attempt < 2; attempt++ {
				rpcErr := requireServedJSONRPCError(t, rt.Endpoint, "run.fork", params)
				details, ok := rpcErr.Data["details"].(map[string]any)
				if rpcErr.Code != -32603 || !ok {
					t.Fatalf("unexpected capability RPC refusal: %+v", rpcErr)
				}
				failure := decodeServedFailureEnvelope(t, details["failure"])
				if string(failure.Class) != "platform.dependency_unavailable" || failure.Detail.Code != "selected_contract_deferred_work_owner_unavailable" || failure.Component != "selected-contract-run-fork" || failure.Operation != "admit-deferred-work-ownership" || !failure.Retryable || failure.Deterministic {
					t.Fatalf("wrong typed capability refusal: %+v", failure)
				}
				raw, err := json.Marshal(failure.Detail.Attributes["capabilities"])
				if err != nil || string(raw) != `["dynamic_flow_instance_creation"]` {
					t.Fatalf("wrong exact capability set: %s error=%v", raw, err)
				}
				if after := futurePostRevisionOriginalSnapshotForkReceiverApplication(t, rt); !reflect.DeepEqual(before, after) {
					t.Fatalf("capability refusal attempt %d changed application tables", attempt)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestFuturePostRevisionOriginalSelectedForkReceiverPolicyPermutationBothStores(t *testing.T) {
	receivers := []canonicalrouting.ForkReceiver{
		{Path: "observer", Policy: canonicalrouting.ForkReceiverOptionalAbsent},
		{Path: "optional", Policy: canonicalrouting.ForkReceiverOptionalExisting},
		{Path: "required", Policy: canonicalrouting.ForkReceiverRequiredExisting},
	}
	for _, backend := range []servedparity.Backend{servedparity.BackendDefaultSQLite, servedparity.BackendExplicitPostgres} {
		for _, order := range [][3]int{{0, 1, 2}, {0, 2, 1}, {1, 0, 2}, {1, 2, 0}, {2, 0, 1}, {2, 1, 0}} {
			t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s/recipient_permutations/%d%d%d", backend, order[0], order[1], order[2]), func(t *testing.T) {
				futurePostRevisionOriginalRunForkReceiverOwnershipJourney(t, backend, []canonicalrouting.ForkReceiver{receivers[order[0]], receivers[order[1]], receivers[order[2]]}, false)
			})
		}
		t.Run(string(backend)+"/materializing_mixed", func(t *testing.T) {
			futurePostRevisionOriginalRunForkReceiverOwnershipJourney(t, backend, append(append([]canonicalrouting.ForkReceiver{}, receivers...), canonicalrouting.ForkReceiver{Path: "created", Policy: canonicalrouting.ForkReceiverAutoMaterializing}), false)
		})
		t.Run(string(backend)+"/same_owner_two_events_and_duplicate", func(t *testing.T) {
			futurePostRevisionOriginalRunForkReceiverOwnershipJourney(t, backend, receivers, false, futurePostRevisionOriginalForkReceiverJourneyOptions{repeated: true})
		})
	}
}

func TestFuturePostRevisionOriginalSelectedForkReceiverStaticAcquisitionBootRefusal(t *testing.T) {
	root := canonicalrouting.CopyForkReceiverStaticAcquisitionRefusal(t)
	bundle := loadWorkflowValidationBundleAt(t, root)
	report := bootverify.Run(context.Background(), semanticview.Wrap(bundle), bootverify.Options{})
	findings := fmt.Sprint(report.Errors())
	if !strings.Contains(findings, "flow_boundary_create_entity_validation") || !strings.Contains(findings, "stateful static multi-row entity ownership is retired") {
		t.Fatalf("retired static acquisition did not reject at real boot: %s", findings)
	}
}

func TestFuturePostRevisionOriginalSelectedForkReceiverCreateCompilationIsNotDynamicFlowCreation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, policy := range []canonicalrouting.ForkReceiverPolicy{canonicalrouting.ForkReceiverExplicitCreate, canonicalrouting.ForkReceiverAutoMaterializing} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(policy), func(t *testing.T) {
			source := semanticview.Wrap(loadWorkflowValidationBundleAt(t, canonicalrouting.CopyForkReceiverOwnership(t, []canonicalrouting.ForkReceiver{{Path: "consumer", Policy: policy}}, false)))
			found := false
			for _, record := range source.ExecutableNodeRecords() {
				node, err := record.Identity()
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				for event, handler := range source.ExecutableNodeEventHandlers(node) {
					if handler.Action.ID != "" || len(handler.Rules) != 0 || len(handler.OnComplete) != 0 || handler.Join != nil {
						t.Fatalf("fixture unexpectedly carries dynamic action candidates: %s/%s %+v", node.FlowPath(), event, handler)
					}
					if node.FlowPath() == "consumer" && event == "work.ready" {
						found = true
						if handler.CreateEntity != (policy == canonicalrouting.ForkReceiverExplicitCreate) {
							t.Fatalf("compiled create_entity fact differs: %+v", handler)
						}
						t.Logf("consumer/work.ready CreateEntity=%t Action.ID=%q", handler.CreateEntity, handler.Action.ID)
					}
				}
			}
			for flowID := range source.FlowSchemaEntries() {
				for _, pin := range source.FlowInputEventPins(flowID) {
					if pin.Resolution().Mode != runtimecontracts.FlowInputResolutionModeNone {
						t.Fatalf("ordinary create fixture gained resolution: %s %+v", flowID, pin.Resolution())
					}
				}
			}
			if !found {
				t.Fatal("compiled consumer handler absent")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestFuturePostRevisionOriginalServedForkSourceCompletionWithoutForkBothStores(t *testing.T) {
	for _, backend := range []servedparity.Backend{servedparity.BackendDefaultSQLite, servedparity.BackendExplicitPostgres} {
		t.Run(string(backend), func(t *testing.T) {
			rt := startServedTestSetupEntitiesProofRuntimeFromSource(t, backend, canonicalrouting.CopyForkDeliveryRouteEvidence(t))
			seed := requireServedEventPublishRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, map[string]any{"event_name": "parent.seeded", "bundle_hash": rt.BundleHash,
				"payload": map[string]any{"work_id": "no-fork-completion"}, "idempotency_key": "no-fork-seed"})
			waitServedRunDeliveryQuiescence(t, rt.DB, rt.Backend, seed.RunID)
			early := readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, seed.RunID)
			futurePostRevisionOriginalWaitForkReceiverSourceCompletion(t, rt, seed.RunID)
			settled := readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, seed.RunID)
			columnsRows, err := rt.DB.Query(`SELECT * FROM event_deliveries WHERE 1=0`)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			columns, err := columnsRows.Columns()
			columnsRows.Close()
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			handoff := -1
			for i, column := range columns {
				if column == "continuation_handoff_at" {
					handoff = i
				}
			}
			if handoff < 0 {
				t.Fatal("missing delivery handoff fact")
			}
			if len(early["event_deliveries"]) != len(settled["event_deliveries"]) {
				t.Fatal("no-fork observation added or removed deliveries")
			}
			for i, raw := range early["event_deliveries"] {
				var beforeRow, afterRow []any
				if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &beforeRow); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(settled["event_deliveries"][i]), &afterRow); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if beforeRow[handoff] != nil && !reflect.DeepEqual(beforeRow[handoff], afterRow[handoff]) {
					t.Fatal("no-fork completion rewrote an existing handoff")
				}
				if afterRow[handoff] == nil {
					t.Fatal("pipeline completion left absent handoff")
				}
				beforeRow[handoff] = afterRow[handoff]
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(beforeRow, afterRow) {
					t.Fatalf("no-fork delivery changed beyond handoff stamp: %v / %v", beforeRow, afterRow)
				}
			}
			for _, receipt := range early["event_receipts"] {
				found := false
				for _, after := range settled["event_receipts"] {
					if receipt == after {
						found = true
					}
				}
				if !found {
					t.Fatal("no-fork completion rewrote an existing receipt")
				}
			}
			var nonPipeline int
			if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_receipts WHERE event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM events WHERE run_id=$1) AND (subscriber_type<>'platform' OR subscriber_id<>'pipeline' OR outcome<>'success' OR reason_code<>'pipeline_persisted')`, seed.RunID).Scan(&nonPipeline); err != nil || nonPipeline != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected source receipts: count=%d err=%v", nonPipeline, err)
			}
			var changed []string
			for table, rows := range early {
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(rows, settled[table]) {
					changed = append(changed, table)
					if table != "event_receipts" && table != "event_deliveries" {
						t.Fatalf("no-fork source changed business domain %s: before=%v after=%v", table, rows, settled[table])
					}
				}
			}
			sort.Strings(changed)
			t.Logf("NO FORK INVOKED: delivery-only quiescence -> pipeline completion changed=%v receipts=%d->%d", changed, len(early["event_receipts"]), len(settled["event_receipts"]))
			waitServedRunDeliveryQuiescence(t, rt.DB, rt.Backend, seed.RunID)
			if after := readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, seed.RunID); !reflect.DeepEqual(settled, after) {
				t.Fatal("source continued changing after exact pipeline handoff/receipt boundary")
			}
		})
	}
}

func futurePostRevisionOriginalRequireForkReceiverBusinessMutation(t *testing.T, rt servedControlProofRuntime, runID, eventID, entityID string) events.DeliveryRoute {
	t.Helper()
	var exact []servedForkDeliveryEvidence
	var deliveryID string
	for id, delivery := range readServedForkDeliveryEvidence(t, rt, runID) {
		if node, ok := delivery.route.Recipient.Node(); delivery.eventID == eventID && ok && node.FlowPath() == "consumer" && node.NodeID() == "collector" {
			exact = append(exact, delivery)
			deliveryID = id
		}
	}
	if len(exact) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("business receiver deliveries=%d", len(exact))
	}
	route := exact[0].route
	handler, local, ok := route.ConnectClaim.NodeHandlerOwner()
	wantTarget := events.RouteIdentity{FlowID: "consumer", FlowInstance: "consumer", EntityID: entityID}
	if !ok || handler.FlowPath() != "consumer" || handler.NodeID() != "collector" || local != "work.ready" || route.Target.Code() != "existing_entity" || route.Target.Route() != wantTarget {
		t.Fatalf("business receiver authority: %+v", route)
	}
	var status, outcome string
	var claim, outcomeClaim, outcomes int
	if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT d.status,d.claim_version,o.outcome,o.claim_version FROM event_deliveries d JOIN event_delivery_outcomes o ON o.delivery_id=d.delivery_id WHERE d.run_id=$1 AND d.delivery_id=$2`, runID, deliveryID).Scan(&status, &claim, &outcome, &outcomeClaim); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_delivery_outcomes WHERE delivery_id=$1`, deliveryID).Scan(&outcomes); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if status != "delivered" || outcome != "delivered" || claim != 1 || outcomeClaim != 1 || outcomes != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("business receiver settlement: %s/%s claims=%d/%d outcomes=%d", status, outcome, claim, outcomeClaim, outcomes)
	}
	var public operatorread.OperatorEventFull
	requireServedJSONRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, "event.get", map[string]any{"event_id": eventID}, &public)
	if public.RunID != runID || len(public.Deliveries) != 1 || public.Deliveries[0].DeliveryID != deliveryID || public.Deliveries[0].Status != "delivered" || public.Deliveries[0].Target != (operatorread.OperatorDeliveryTarget{Kind: "existing_entity", FlowID: "consumer", FlowInstance: "consumer", EntityID: entityID}) {
		t.Fatalf("public business receiver evidence: %+v", public)
	}
	var oldJSON, newJSON, writerType, writerID, step string
	if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT CAST(old_value AS TEXT),CAST(new_value AS TEXT),writer_type,writer_id,handler_step FROM entity_mutations WHERE run_id=$1 AND entity_id=$2 AND caused_by_event=$3 AND domain='authored_field' AND path='processed_token'`, runID, entityID, eventID).Scan(&oldJSON, &newJSON, &writerType, &writerID, &step); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var oldValue, newValue string
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(oldJSON), &oldValue); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(newJSON), &newValue); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if oldValue != "seeded" || newValue != "receiver-proof" || writerType != "platform" || writerID != "workflow_engine" || step != "mutate" {
		t.Fatalf("receiver business mutation: old=%q new=%q writer=%s/%s step=%s", oldValue, newValue, writerType, writerID, step)
	}
	var mutations, emitted int
	if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entity_mutations WHERE run_id=$1 AND caused_by_event=$2 AND domain='authored_field' AND path='processed_token'`, runID, eventID).Scan(&mutations); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Runtime log records are admitted diagnostics, not authored emissions.
	if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE run_id=$1 AND source_event_id=$2 AND NOT (event_class=$3 AND event_name=$4)`, runID, eventID, string(events.EventAdmissionDiagnosticDirect), string(events.EventTypePlatformRuntimeLog)).Scan(&emitted); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if mutations != 1 || emitted != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("business effect census: mutations=%d emitted=%d", mutations, emitted)
	}
	var extraDeliveries int
	if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_deliveries d JOIN events e ON e.event_id=d.event_id WHERE e.run_id=$1 AND e.source_event_id=$2`, runID, eventID).Scan(&extraDeliveries); err != nil || extraDeliveries != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("effect-only consumer produced executable downstream work: deliveries=%d err=%v", extraDeliveries, err)
	}
	return route
}

func TestFuturePostRevisionOriginalSelectedForkIndependentReceiverBusinessMutationBothStores(t *testing.T) {
	for _, backend := range []servedparity.Backend{servedparity.BackendDefaultSQLite, servedparity.BackendExplicitPostgres} {
		for _, entityless := range []bool{false, true} {
			t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s/entityless_producer=%t", backend, entityless), func(t *testing.T) {
				rt := startServedTestSetupEntitiesProofRuntimeFromSource(t, backend, canonicalrouting.CopyForkReceiverBusinessMutationOwnership(t, entityless))
				seed := requireServedEventPublishRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, map[string]any{"event_name": "start.seeded", "bundle_hash": rt.BundleHash, "payload": map[string]any{"token": "receiver-proof"}, "idempotency_key": "business-seed"})
				waitServedRunDeliveryQuiescence(t, rt.DB, rt.Backend, seed.RunID)
				futurePostRevisionOriginalWaitForkReceiverSourceCompletion(t, rt, seed.RunID)
				seedRows := futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverRows(t, rt, seed.RunID)
				if got := seedRows["consumer"]; got.Type != "receipt" || got.State != "active" || got.Fields["marker"] != "consumer-owned" || got.Fields["processed_token"] != "seeded" {
					t.Fatalf("receiver seed ownership: %+v", seedRows)
				}
				started := requireServedEventPublishRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, map[string]any{"event_name": "start.requested", "run_id": seed.RunID, "source_event_id": seed.EventID, "payload": map[string]any{"token": "receiver-proof"}, "idempotency_key": "business-request"})
				if started.RunID != seed.RunID {
					t.Fatal("source request escaped seeded run")
				}
				waitServedRunDeliveryQuiescence(t, rt.DB, rt.Backend, seed.RunID)
				futurePostRevisionOriginalWaitForkReceiverSourceCompletion(t, rt, seed.RunID)
				var frontier string
				if err := rt.DB.QueryRow(`SELECT event_id FROM events WHERE run_id=$1 AND event_name='producer/work.ready'`, seed.RunID).Scan(&frontier); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				sourceRows := futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverRows(t, rt, seed.RunID)
				consumer := sourceRows["consumer"]
				if consumer.ID != seedRows["consumer"].ID || consumer.Fields["marker"] != "consumer-owned" || consumer.Fields["processed_token"] != "receiver-proof" || consumer.State != "active" {
					t.Fatalf("source receiver effect ownership: %+v", sourceRows)
				}
				producer, exists := sourceRows["producer"]
				if exists == entityless || (exists && (producer.ID == consumer.ID || producer.Type != "work" || producer.Fields["marker"] != "producer-owned")) {
					t.Fatalf("source producer ownership: %+v", sourceRows)
				}
				sourceEvidence := futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverProducerEvidence(t, rt, seed.RunID, frontier)
				if sourceEvidence.Source.Kind() != events.RoutingSourceStaticFlow || sourceEvidence.Source.Route() != (events.RouteIdentity{FlowID: "producer", FlowInstance: "producer", EntityID: producer.ID}) {
					t.Fatalf("immutable producer evidence: %+v", sourceEvidence)
				}
				sourceRoute := futurePostRevisionOriginalRequireForkReceiverBusinessMutation(t, rt, seed.RunID, frontier, consumer.ID)
				before, companions := readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, seed.RunID), futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverCompanions(t, rt, seed.RunID)
				defer func() {
					if !reflect.DeepEqual(before, readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, seed.RunID)) || !reflect.DeepEqual(companions, futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverCompanions(t, rt, seed.RunID)) {
						t.Error("business fork changed settled source domain or companions")
					}
				}()
				params := map[string]any{"source_run_id": seed.RunID, "fork_event_id": frontier, "confirm_source_freeze": true, "idempotency_key": "business-fork"}
				var fork, replay apiv1.RunForkExecutionResult
				requireServedJSONRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, "run.fork", params, &fork)
				if fork.SourceRunID != seed.RunID || fork.ForkEventID != frontier || fork.ForkRunID == "" || fork.ForkRunID == seed.RunID || fork.ExecutedEventCount != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("business fork identity: %+v", fork)
				}
				waitServedRunDeliveryQuiescence(t, rt.DB, rt.Backend, fork.ForkRunID)
				childEvent := activityidentity.ForkLineageEventID(fork.ForkRunID, frontier)
				childRoute := futurePostRevisionOriginalRequireForkReceiverBusinessMutation(t, rt, fork.ForkRunID, childEvent, consumer.ID)
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(sourceRoute.ConnectClaim, childRoute.ConnectClaim) || futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverProducerEvidence(t, rt, fork.ForkRunID, childEvent) != sourceEvidence {
					t.Fatal("business fork changed compiled consumer or immutable producer evidence")
				}
				childRows := futurePostRevisionOriginalReadForkReceiverRows(t, rt, fork.ForkRunID)
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(childRows["consumer"], consumer) || !reflect.DeepEqual(childRows["producer"], producer) {
					t.Fatalf("business fork rehomed producer/receiver: source=%+v child=%+v", sourceRows, childRows)
				}
				root := childRows[fork.ForkRunID]
				if root.ID != fork.ForkRunID || root.Type != "root" || root.Fields["marker"] != "root-owned" {
					t.Fatalf("business fork root remapping: %+v", childRows)
				}
				childBefore := readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, fork.ForkRunID)
				requireServedJSONRPCResult(t, rt.Endpoint, "run.fork", params, &replay)
				if !reflect.DeepEqual(fork, replay) || !reflect.DeepEqual(childBefore, readServedForkRecipientSourceDomain(t, rt, fork.ForkRunID)) {
					t.Fatal("business fork replay repeated execution or changed response")
				}
			})
		}
	}
}

func TestFuturePostRevisionOriginalSelectedForkIndependentProducerReceiverEntitiesBothStores(t *testing.T) {
	for _, backend := range []servedparity.Backend{servedparity.BackendDefaultSQLite, servedparity.BackendExplicitPostgres} {
		for _, entityless := range []bool{false, true} {
			name := "distinct"
			if entityless {
				name = "entityless_producer"
			}
			t.Run(string(backend)+"/"+name, func(t *testing.T) {
				futurePostRevisionOriginalRunForkReceiverOwnershipJourney(t, backend, []canonicalrouting.ForkReceiver{{Path: "consumer", Policy: canonicalrouting.ForkReceiverRequiredExisting}}, entityless)
			})
		}
	}
}
